title: 第十七章 灵运城天人坊第十八章 降维打击
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了

;;
这正气凛然，恩怨分明的话，听的浪三刀二人，面皮抽抽，起了一身的鸡皮疙瘩，这还是他们那个如狼似虎，阴险狡诈的师兄吗？
“狗贼，惯会用这种把戏，收买人心！”
吴山黛心中大骂，表面还要露出欣慰佩服的笑意。
赢商不管，昂首挺胸，目光坦荡，一身白袍飘飞。
造型必须要帅，表面必须正派，现在的修真界的小辈，就爱吃这一套。
果然！
青年闻言，神色更加复杂起来，恨意似有瓦解迹象，一幅心神遭受冲击的样子，但马上就是狐疑涌起。在怒火道宗呆的时间虽然不长，但也见到了极多肮脏事。
“老贼，你到底想干什么？”
我想跟你——多诞生一点羁绊。
赢商微微一笑。
……
耍了一通帅，赢商带着二人离开。
一边飞去，一边将门中事情交代起来。
目前能帮他的，只有浪三刀和吴山黛二人，浪三刀又更值得信任，看守剑横秋七人的事情，就交给了他。
那些外门弟子，和才放出去的那一批，则是交给吴山黛，主要是盯着他们的修炼。
宗门现在，就是一个空壳子，什么藏经阁，草药山，矿脉，全是空的，没有太多可说的，关起门来，就是专心修炼！
而当下，赢商在安排好后，先演练起道法神通来，包括浪三刀的金行法术，一开始，还有些生涩，但飞快的就熟练起来。
传授的浪三刀，瞪大眼睛，如同见鬼，不光是仿佛看到另外一个自己，更无法理解的是——自己的带头大哥，什么时候拥有了金灵根的资质？当年师傅检测错了？
……

这一天，赢商终于飞向山门方向。
“宝灵，虫姥姥，高墙，解战袍他们，有没有守在山门外？山野中有人盯着？他们只要盯着，应该就算和我诞生了天道羁绊，你该都能察觉到的吧？”
一边飞去，一边再次问向宝灵。
“没人。”
宝灵冰冷机械的声音，很快响起。
这是仙门社稷令的另外一重小玄妙，可以察觉到，与赢商有天道羁绊的修士的行踪，不过似乎有范围的限制。
虽然如此，这桩小玄妙，用的好了，说不定也能起到大用处。
……
穿云过雾。
赢商自从境界跌落之后，终于第一次出了山门来。
一出山门，就是巨大的黑暗地裂，整个怒火道宗，仿佛成了一个孤岛一般，耸立在一根巨大的土柱上。
放眼望去，之前大战的痕迹，清晰可见。
幸亏守山大阵够硬，否则山中灵气必定更加流逝，而这座灵山，已经和赢商绑定，与他共荣，灵气流逝多了，赢商的样子，会再次苍老，生机寿元，也会渐渐流失。
“不能再把战火，烧到山门来。”
赢商心中喃喃。
但他控制的了自己，还控制的了对手吗？心里也很清楚，最好的办法，还是自己变的更强，震慑住每一个对手。
回过神来，释放出灵识，扫向四面八方里。
灵识是元气之外的，一种精神力量，修炼成之后，可以像眼睛一样，扫视四面八方里，哪怕是深重的黑暗，也看的清清楚楚，十分玄妙。
同时，也是祭炼法宝，储物袋子，储物戒指，等东西的必须力量。据说厉害的修士，还能催动灵识，化为神通，来攻击对手的心神意志。
赢商之前，服下假丹，境界狂跌，但灵识力量却保住了，一点没掉，依然是相气后期的水准，此刻一扫之下，直径百里。

百里之外，除了地裂，便是被打烂变形的荒山野岭，九年过去，又被野草藤蔓，覆盖的严严实实，一片蛮荒景象。
除此之外，不见修士。
……

Hearing these words of righteousness and clear distinction between grievances and grievances, the Langsandao duo felt twitchy and had goosebumps all over their bodies. Is this still their wolf-like, tiger-like, insidious and cunning senior brother?
"Thieves are used to using tricks like this to win people's hearts!"
Wu Shandai cursed in her heart, but showed a smile of relief and admiration on the outside.
The winning businessman doesn't care, he holds his head high, his eyes are magnanimous, and his white robe is flying.
The appearance must be handsome and the appearance must be decent. The juniors in the current cultivation world love this.
really!
When the young man heard this, his expression became even more complicated. His hatred seemed to be disintegrating, and he looked like his mind was being shocked, but suspicion immediately arose. Although I didn't stay in Fury Dao Sect for a long time, I also saw a lot of dirty things.
"Old thief, what do you want to do?"
I want to create more bonds with you.
Yingshang smiled slightly.
…
After a lot of acting, Yingshang took the two of them away.
While flying away, he explained what happened in the door.
Currently, the only two people who can help him are Lang Sandao and Wu Shandai. Lang Sandao is more trustworthy, so the matter of guarding Jian Hengqiu's seven people is left to him.
Those outer sect disciples, as well as the group that had just been released, were handed over to Wu Shandai, mainly to keep an eye on their cultivation.
The sect is now an empty shell. The Sutra Pavilion, Herb Mountain, and Mineral Veins are all empty. There is not much to say. Behind closed doors, we just concentrate on cultivation!
At the moment, after making arrangements, Ying Shang first practiced Taoist and magical powers, including the golden spell of Langsandao. At the beginning, it was a bit unfamiliar, but he quickly became proficient.
The taught Langsandao's eyes widened, as if he had seen a ghost. Not only did he seem to see another version of himself, but what he couldn't understand was - when did his leading brother possess the qualifications of the Golden Spiritual Root? Did the master test it wrong back then?
…
On this day, Yingshang finally flew towards the mountain gate.
"Are Bao Ling, Grandma Chong, Gao Qiang, Ji Zizhan and the others guarding the mountain gate? Is there anyone watching in the mountains? As long as they watch, they should be born with the bond of heaven, and you should be able to detect it, right?"
While flying away, he asked Xiang Baoling again.
"Nobody."
Baoling's cold mechanical voice soon sounded.
This is another small mystery of the Xianmen Sheji Order. It can detect the whereabouts of monks who are bound by heaven to Ying Shang, but it seems to be limited in scope.
Even so, this little mystery may be of great use if used well.
…
Through the clouds and fog.
Yingshang finally came out of the mountain gate for the first time since his realm fell.
As soon as they walked out of the mountain gate, there was a huge dark crack in the ground. The entire Wrath Dao Sect seemed to be an isolated island, standing on a huge earth pillar.
Looking around, the traces of the previous battle are clearly visible.
Fortunately, the mountain guarding formation was strong enough, otherwise the spiritual energy in the mountain would have lost even more, and this spiritual mountain has been bound to Ying Shang and prospered with him. If the spiritual energy disappeared too much, Ying Shang would look old again, and his vitality and longevity would gradually disappear.
"We can no longer bring the flames of war to the mountain gate."
Yingshang murmured in his heart.
But if he can control himself, can he also control his opponent? I also know very well in my heart that the best way is to become stronger and frighten every opponent.
After coming back to his senses, he released his spiritual consciousness and swept it in all directions.
Spiritual consciousness is a kind of spiritual power other than vitality. After it is cultivated, it can scan all directions like eyes. Even in deep darkness, it can be seen clearly and mysteriously.
At the same time, it is also a necessary power for refining magic weapons, storage bags, storage rings, etc. It is said that powerful monks can also activate spiritual consciousness and turn it into supernatural powers to attack the opponent's mind and will.
Before Ying Shang, he took the fake elixir and his level plummeted, but the power of his spiritual consciousness was preserved and not lost at all. It was still at the level of the late stage of Xiangqi. At this moment, it was swept awayBelow, it is hundreds of miles in diameter.
A hundred miles away, apart from the cracked ground, there were deformed and broken mountains and wild mountains. Nine years later, they were covered tightly with weeds and vines, creating a wild scene.
Apart from that, there were no monks in sight.
…
